description: Fill missing translations with the configured provider (what `verbaly translate` does). The default provider is Claude, which needs @anthropic-ai/sdk and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. Every new translation is saved as a draft awaiting human review (`verbaly review`), which no tool here can approve. A batch the provider never answers is reported in failed and everything else stays written, so a retry only asks for what is left. dryRun lists what would be translated without calling the provider. To see what is missing first, use verbaly_missing; to save translations you wrote yourself, verbaly_write_drafts.

dryRun.description: List missing entries per locale, call no provider

root.description: Project root holding verbaly.config (defaults to the server working directory)

name: verbaly_translate

failed.description: Batches the provider never answered, safe to retry

invalid.description: Rejected: params or tags were not preserved

kept.description: Written on disk by someone else while the provider worked, so left as they were

pending.description: dryRun only: what would be translated

translated.description: Saved as drafts, a human still has to approve them

title: Machine-translate missing entries
